# Sixth Gear

> Sixth Gear is an AI automation and transformation partner. We build, run, and continuously optimise AI workflows against the KPIs that matter to your business, so your team can grow bigger, not busier.

Sixth Gear is an AI automation and transformation partner. It designs, builds, runs and continuously optimises AI workflows for businesses, measured against each client's own KPIs. Tagline: "Your business, in a higher gear."

## What Sixth Gear does
- **AI workflow automation**: We design and build AI workflows that take over repetitive, manual work across support, operations and back-office processes.
- **Managed AI operations**: We run your AI workflows in production and continuously optimise them against the KPIs you care about, such as turnaround time, cost per task and hours saved.
- **AI support agents**: AI agents that handle routine customer support queries and investigate issues, with humans reviewing the work that matters.
- **Free AI transformation workshop**: A free worksheet-led workshop to identify bottlenecks, assess readiness and risks, build a cost and outcome case, and plan a pilot.

## Outcomes Sixth Gear delivers
- 24/7 operational coverage
- 10+ hours saved per employee per week
- 3× more workflows handled per team
- 80% of routine support queries handled by AI
- 2× faster turnaround
- 50% less manual processing

## Case studies
- **Customer Service, 4× faster support investigation.** An AI support agent that investigates bugs, reproduces issues in a sandbox, and prepares tested fixes as draft PRs for engineering review.
- **Field Operations, 65% less manual data entry.** An AI-powered workflow that brings field data capture, rule-based calculations, and report drafting into one streamlined process.

## Platforms and models used
Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, ElevenLabs, Typesafe, Google Cloud, AWS, Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce.

## Free AI transformation workshop
The free worksheet helps teams:
01. Identify bottlenecks and map the workflow
02. Assess readiness and risks
03. Build a case estimating costs and outcomes

## Relevant topics

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Sixth Gear do?
Sixth Gear builds, runs, and continuously optimises AI workflows for businesses. We automate the repetitive work slowing your team down and measure every workflow against the KPIs that matter to you.

### What kind of results can AI workflow automation deliver?
Across our work we target outcomes such as 24/7 operational coverage, 10+ hours saved per employee per week, 3× more workflows handled per team, 80% of routine support queries handled by AI, 2× faster turnaround and 50% less manual processing.

### Which industries and processes does Sixth Gear automate?
Examples include customer service, where an AI support agent made support investigation 4× faster, and field operations, where an AI workflow cut manual data entry by 65%.

### Which AI models and platforms do you work with?
We build on Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi and ElevenLabs, and integrate with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake and Salesforce.

### How do I start an AI transformation project with Sixth Gear?
Start with our free workshop worksheet, which helps you identify bottlenecks, assess readiness and risks, estimate costs and outcomes, and plan a pilot. You can also book a call with our founder at https://cal.com/aswin-kumar-kp/build-with-us.

### Do you only build the AI workflow, or also run it?
We do both. Sixth Gear builds the workflow, runs it in production, and keeps optimising it against your KPIs over time.

## Glossary

- **AI transformation**: The process of redesigning how a business operates so that AI systems take on meaningful parts of the work, measured by business outcomes such as cost, speed, quality and capacity rather than by the technology deployed.
- **AI workflow automation**: Using AI models, usually large language models combined with integrations and rules, to carry out multi-step business processes such as triaging tickets, extracting data from documents or drafting reports, with humans reviewing where judgement matters.
- **AI agent**: Software that uses an AI model to plan and take actions toward a goal, such as reading a support ticket, reproducing a bug and drafting a fix, rather than only generating a single response.
- **Human-in-the-loop**: A workflow design in which people review, approve or correct AI output at defined checkpoints, so automation scales without giving up control over important decisions.
- **KPI-driven AI**: An approach where every AI workflow is tied to a business metric (for example hours saved, turnaround time or share of queries resolved) and is tuned continuously against that metric after launch.
- **AI pilot**: A time-boxed, limited-scope deployment of an AI workflow on one real process, used to prove value against agreed KPIs before scaling.
- **AI readiness assessment**: A structured review of a team’s processes, data, systems, risks and skills to decide where AI can be applied safely and with the highest return.
- **Workflow bottleneck**: The step in a process that limits overall throughput, often manual data entry, hand-offs, or repetitive investigation, and usually the best first candidate for automation.
